description: Get global email statistics over a date range (delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, spam reports, etc.). Returns an array of { date, stats: [{ metrics: {...} }] }. SendGrid: GET /v3/stats.

aggregated_by.description: How to group the returned statistics.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination).

name: sendgrid_get_stats
title: Get email stats
